title: Forget a saved Wi-Fi network on macOS
summary: Remove a saved Wi-Fi network from your Mac so it stops joining that network automatically. You can connect to it again later with the password.

aliases.text: мак сам подключается к старому wifi
как убрать wifi из сохраненных на макбуке
удалить сеть wi-fi из списка mac

prerequisites: Know the exact name of the Wi-Fi network you want to forget

steps.explain: List the Mac's network hardware ports to find the Wi-Fi port name. This only reads information and changes nothing.
steps.expect: A block that starts with 'Hardware Port: Wi-Fi' and has a 'Device:' line below it, such as en0.

steps.explain: List the Wi-Fi networks this Mac has saved. Copy the exact name of the network you want to forget. This only reads information and changes nothing.

placeholders.name: WIFI_PORT
placeholders.description: The Wi-Fi hardware port name from the first step.

steps.expect: A header such as 'Preferred networks on Wi-Fi:' followed by one saved network name per indented line.

steps.explain: Remove the network from the saved list, so this Mac stops joining it automatically. If you are connected to it now, the Mac disconnects. An administrator password is required.

placeholders.name: WIFI_PORT
placeholders.description: The Wi-Fi hardware port name from the first step.

placeholders.name: SSID
placeholders.description: The exact saved network name from the list. Put it in double quotes if it has spaces.

steps.expect: No message when it works, and the prompt returns. You may be asked for your Mac login password first.

verify.expect: The network you removed is no longer in the list of saved networks.

rollback.explain: To use the network again, connect to it with the Connect to a Wi-Fi network card (see see_also), or pick it from the Wi-Fi menu in the menu bar and type the password. Forgetting does not change the network itself.

warnings: If you are connected to the network you forget, your Mac disconnects from it right away.
The command needs administrator rights (sudo). Run it only on a Mac you are allowed to administer.
The network name must match the saved entry exactly, including upper and lower case. A wrong name removes nothing.
To connect to this network again later, use the macos-connect-to-wifi-network card and enter the password.
